name: rygentic-harness
description: rygentic-harness: a marketplace of Claude Code plugins. mightymodels is the ticket-scoped agent dev loop and its review stack; more plugins land alongside it.

plugins.name: mightymodels
plugins.description: Ticket-scoped development loop built from the failures of spec-driven development: human-in-the-loop decisions, per-ticket state and model routing, and evidence-first verification

plugins.name: vibe-code
plugins.description: Eleven skills for building, hardening and tuning Claude Code agents, skills, hooks, instructions, MCP servers, and loops, plus a vibe-code CLI that needs uv on PATH.

plugins.name: python-harness
plugins.description: Python engineering for Claude Code: reviews and refactor plans grounded in deterministic facts and cited pylens fact-gathering, standard-library docs on demand, and hooks that brief each session on the project's Python toolchain and a note whenever a Bash command runs plain python instead of uv run python.
